name: Uncategorized — 5 Level 5 — Touch the Protector's Mind

system.description:
This ritual links the caster's mind with that of Telyavel, the Lithuanian protector of the dead, used only in extreme circumstances such as an invading army threatening the sorcerer's realm. Success grants 10 dice to allot among the vampire's Physical or Mental Attributes (none may exceed their normal maximum), causes all her Disciplines to function as if she had one additional level (even letting her use powers she has not yet mastered), and grants the ability to remain awake through daylight hours with some immunity to sunlight, provided she stays out of direct rays. The effect lasts from one moonrise to the next.

System: The vampire spends one hour in meditation, then expends five blood points and rolls Willpower (difficulty 9). A single success puts her in contact with Telyavel's mind. No successes mean the attempt fails; a botch inflicts five levels of aggravated damage (soakable) and risks a permanent Derangement (resisted with a Willpower roll) from the god's touch.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Two: Usurpers
